Method of Attack: Downloads files from an Amazon AWS S3 bucket
Replaces legitimate binary files with malicious ones
Harvests user data such as login credentials and credit card numbers
Impacted Systems: Open-source software packages relying on S3 buckets for binary distribution
Attack Vector: Abandoned Amazon S3 buckets used to distribute malicious binaries
Indicators of Compromise: Abandoned S3 bucket with identical name created by attacker
Malicious binary files replacing legitimate ones
